title: Withdraw a small PS balance at normal tax

ask.psWithdrawalsStarted: Have you already started regular withdrawals from your PS account?

message: If your total PS savings were no more than {max} € on {figure3} January {figure4} and scheduled retirement withdrawals have not begun, you may qualify to withdraw the whole balance in {figure5} or {figure6} without punitive tax uplift. Normal tax still applies. Today’s balance alone does not establish eligibility.
earns: Nordea earns nothing from this information.

tests.name: the deduction rule is gone on 1 January

_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
explain: Eligible PS contributions paid in {figure7} can still qualify for a deduction, generally within a combined annual {figure8} € cap with voluntary individual pension insurance and other eligibility limits. The balance is not deductible. Contributions from {figure9} January {figure10} are not deductible. If total PS savings were no more than {figure11} € ON {figure12} January {figure13} the whole balance may qualify for withdrawal in {figure14} or {figure15} without punitive tax uplift, provided scheduled retirement withdrawals have not begun. Withdrawal remains taxable under normal rules, not tax-free; final tax depends on total capital income. Do not assume earlier contributions were deducted.
